culprit_citations.quoted_text: Structured Credit Partners JV, LLC, Class A | Investment Funds | blank Reference Rate, Spread, and Interest Rate | Par/Principal Amount 1 | Cost 1 | Fair Value 1
Structured Credit Partners JV, LLC, Class C | Investment Funds | blank Reference Rate, Spread, and Interest Rate | Par/Principal Amount, Cost, and Fair Value shown as dashes
Structured Credit Partners JV, LLC, Class B | Investment Funds | FIXED | 10.74% Spread | 10.74% Interest Rate

rationale: Class 2 review. The raw schedule identifies Classes A and C as Investment Funds and leaves their Reference Rate, Spread, and Interest Rate fields blank; Class C also has no carrying value, while Class A is a nominal $1 interest. The immediately adjacent Class B is the rate-bearing class and explicitly reports FIXED and 10.74%. Thus the source supports the missing values for A and C, and X02 is firing because fund interests were placed within PRIVATE_CREDIT rule scope rather than because rate data was omitted.
